washerConfigurations.name: Heavy-Duty 12-Module Continuous Batch Tunnel Washer (316L Stainless Steel, Automated Counter-Flow Heat Recovery, FKM Viton® Gaskets, Direct Vent Scrubber)
washerConfigurations.drumMaterial: AISI 316L Passivated Austenitic Stainless Steel (2.1% Mo)
washerConfigurations.description: High-throughput commercial batch tunnel washer engineered for volume airline flight catering and industrial food processing crates. Continuous counter-flow cascading minimizes water consumption, while 316L molybdenum-bearing metallurgy and fluoroelastomer seals withstand continuous 200 ppm peracetic acid exposure.

washerConfigurations.name: High-Speed Modular Lug/Crate Sanitizing Tunnel Washer (304 Stainless Steel, Standard Peroxide-Cured EPDM Seals, Natural Draught Flue)
washerConfigurations.description: Widely deployed modular wash tunnel for bakery racks, poultry tubs, and produce lugs. Standard 304 stainless steel construction provides good general corrosion resistance, but non-molybdenum metallurgy is vulnerable to crevice pitting in unpassivated weld heat-affected zones (HAZ) under warm acidic sanitizer conditions.

washerConfigurations.name: Airline In-Flight Catering Cart & Ware Batch Tunnel (304 Stainless Steel Cavity, EPDM Manifold O-Rings, Exhaust Fan Interlock)
washerConfigurations.description: Specialized flight kitchen wash tunnel cycling Atlas airline carts, polycarbonate meal trays, and stainless steel gastronorm pans. High cycling frequency and detergent carry-over can neutralize sanitizer acidity or accelerate gasket elastomer swelling.

washerConfigurations.name: Aging 15-Year Institutional Continuous Wash Tunnel (Aged 304 Welds, Degraded Nitrile NBR Seals, Defective Exhaust Draft)
washerConfigurations.drumMaterial: Sensitized 304 Stainless Steel (Intergranular Pitting & Carbide Precipitation)
washerConfigurations.gasketMaterial: Degraded Nitrile NBR (Durometer 88 Shore A - Severe Embrittlement)
washerConfigurations.description: High-risk unmaintained institutional wash tunnel. Welds exhibit micro-fissuring and rust bloom staining from persistent chloride and peracetic acid attack. Hardened Nitrile gaskets show extensive micro-cracking, leading to manifold spray leaks and hazardous headspace PAA vapor leakage into the scullery.

washerConfigurations.name: Ultra-Sanitary 2205 Duplex Stainless Steel Continuous Tunnel (PTFE Envelope Gaskets, Active Catalytic Vapor Scrubber)
washerConfigurations.gasketMaterial: Expanded PTFE Envelope Gaskets with FKM Core
washerConfigurations.description: Top-tier hygienic continuous wash tunnel designed for infant formula packaging and cleanroom foodservice operations. 2205 Duplex metallurgy offers near-immunity to chloride stress corrosion cracking and pitting up to 80°C, while PTFE envelope gaskets guarantee zero chemical swelling.

elastomerTypes.name: FKM Fluoroelastomer (Viton® A / 66% Fluorine)
elastomerTypes.description: Fluorocarbon elastomer offering elite resistance to peracetic acid, acetic acid, hydrogen peroxide, and organic sanitizers. Polymer backbone resists oxidative chain scission, maintaining elasticity and seal torque over multi-year wash cycles.

elastomerTypes.name: Peroxide-Cured EPDM (Ethylene Propylene Diene Monomer)
elastomerTypes.paaChemicalCompatibility: Good for Dilute PAA (Grade B - Conditional)
elastomerTypes.description: Standard sanitary gasket in food and beverage piping. Peroxide cure provides significantly better oxidative stability than sulfur-cured EPDM. Performs reliably at typical sanitizing dilutions (<200 ppm PAA), but shows progressive volumetric swelling and softening if PAA spikes above 300 ppm.

elastomerTypes.name: Expanded PTFE (ePTFE / Gylon® 3504 Structured)
elastomerTypes.description: 100% fluoropolymer gasket material impervious to all concentrations of peracetic acid, glacial acetic acid, and hydrogen peroxide. Zero chemical swell and zero extractables. Requires adequate bolt pre-load to prevent cold-flow mechanical relaxation.

elastomerTypes.name: Nitrile Buna-N (NBR Rubber)
elastomerTypes.description: Standard petroleum-resistant rubber completely unsuitable for oxidative sanitizers. Peracetic acid and peroxide oxidize the unsaturated nitrile-butadiene polymer chains, causing severe chemical hardening (embrittlement), surface cracking, and catastrophic seal failure within 2 to 6 weeks.

elastomerTypes.name: Platinum-Cured High-Temperature Silicone (VMQ)
elastomerTypes.paaChemicalCompatibility: Fair to Poor (Grade C - Limited Lifespan)
elastomerTypes.description: Excellent thermal elasticity but vulnerable to hydrolytic siloxane chain cleavage under warm acidic conditions. PAA causes substantial volumetric swelling and gummy degradation over continuous immersion.

metallurgyGrades.name: AISI 316L Low-Carbon Austenitic Stainless Steel (17% Cr, 12% Ni, 2.2% Mo)
metallurgyGrades.description: The gold standard for pharmaceutical, dairy, and commercial warewashing sanitizer zones. Molybdenum addition stabilizes the chromium oxide passive layer against organic peroxy acid pitting and dilute chloride attack.

metallurgyGrades.name: AISI 304 Standard Austenitic Stainless Steel (18% Cr, 8% Ni, 0.0% Mo)
metallurgyGrades.description: Standard food-grade stainless steel. Highly effective for general wash compartments, but lacks molybdenum. When exposed to peracetic acid in the presence of even modest chlorides (>50 ppm) or elevated temperatures (>55°C), the passive film breaks down, causing pinpoint micro-pitting in welds and crevices.

metallurgyGrades.name: 2205 Duplex Ferritic-Austenitic Stainless Steel (22% Cr, 5.5% Ni, 3.1% Mo, 0.17% N)
metallurgyGrades.description: Dual-phase microstructure combining high mechanical yield strength with outstanding resistance to localized pitting and chloride stress corrosion cracking. Immune to PAA degradation under all normal commercial wash temperatures.

metallurgyGrades.name: AISI 430 Ferritic Stainless Steel (16% Cr, 0.0% Ni, 0.0% Mo)
metallurgyGrades.description: Economy magnetic stainless steel occasionally used in outer cladding or budget tunnel panels. Rapidly stains, rusts, and pits when in direct contact with peracetic acid aerosols or condensation runoff.

sanitizerProfiles.name: Standard FDA Food Contact Sanitizing PAA (150–200 ppm PAA, pH 4.0–4.8)
sanitizerProfiles.fdaLimitCompliance: Fully Compliant (FDA 21 CFR § 173.315 max 200 ppm no-rinse)
sanitizerProfiles.description: Optimal equilibrium sanitizing concentration. Destroys vegetative pathogens within 30 seconds without requiring a potable water rinse, maintaining passive stainless steel oxide stability.

sanitizerProfiles.name: Intense Meat & Poultry Crate Terminal Sanitizer (280–350 ppm PAA, pH 3.6–4.0)
sanitizerProfiles.fdaLimitCompliance: Requires Subsequent Potable Water Rinse if food contact (>200 ppm)
sanitizerProfiles.description: High-concentration sanitizing wash used for returnable plastic transport crates heavily soiled with animal fats and protein residues. Accelerates elastomer swelling and metal etching if temperature exceeds 55°C.

sanitizerProfiles.name: Unbuffered Over-Dosed PAA Spike (450–500 ppm PAA, pH 3.2, Heavy Acid Fuming)
sanitizerProfiles.description: Chemical dosing pump failure or manual overdosing event. Corrosive acetic acid vapors overwhelm tunnel draft exhaust, causing pungent vinegar/ozone odor in the dishroom, eye irritation, and active acid attack on 304 stainless steel weld seams.

pathogens.name: Listeria monocytogenes (Biofilm Persistence in Wash Tunnels)
pathogens.description: Psychrotrophic pathogen capable of establishing dense extracellular polymeric substance (EPS) biofilms inside wash tunnel crevices, guides, and spray nozzles. PAA penetrates biofilm matrix far more effectively than chlorine or quats due to low molecular size and oxidizing potential.

pathogens.name: Salmonella enterica (Poultry Lug & Crate Cross-Contamination)
pathogens.description: Major pathogen associated with raw poultry and meat processing containers. PAA denatures bacterial cell wall lipoproteins, inducing cytoplasmic leakage and achieving >5-log kill within 15–30 seconds of active contact.

pathogens.name: Bacillus cereus & Geobacillus stearothermophilus Bacterial Spores
pathogens.description: Dormant bacterial endospores possess thick proteinaceous spore coats that resist standard vegetative sanitizers. Achieving true sporicidal reduction in continuous wash tunnels requires elevated PAA concentrations (>250 ppm), temperatures >55°C, and extended contact times.
